_rules.audio_first: Build and measure the audio bed before any picture. The music bed must never be louder than the voice, even in pauses.
_rules.loudness_target: -17 LUFS integrated, true peak <= -1 dBFS, pauses 5-6 dB down
_rules.never_claim: Never claim to have watched or heard anything. Report measured numbers only.
_rules.upload: AX does not upload. K reviews first. Publish only when K says so.
_rules.rename: A display-name change needs K's explicit approval. Direction changes are already confirmed.
_rules.first_work_review: K reviews the FIRST work of each channel. Upload only after K approves. Once approved, the episode shape becomes that channel's template and an automation is created for it.
